Per-pin pose/colour descriptions not found anywhere; only series-wide style (anime/chibi, big-eyed). WDWNT May 2026 notes the box art carries film symbols (e.g. tambourine for Esmeralda, Grecian column for Megara) - box, not pin, so not claimed as pin visuals. No disneystore.co.uk listing found (a GBP figure seen previously only on an excluded source). Series 2 remains single-publisher (Disney Pins Blog article + its Threads post); no WDWNT/official corroboration as of 2026-10-13. Resellers seen but not used: yourwdwstore.net, usshoppingsos.com (titled 'DLR/WDW'), eBay, Mercari. No new pins found.
